title: The roadmap gets re-weighed as a whole, and notes stay short
why: Your question, Oct 26: are we rewriting notes instead of appending, and re-weighing the order instead of putting each new item at the front? Audit, Oct 26 at roadmap 9517045: mostly not.
note:
Audit, Oct 26 (roadmap 9517045, reports/roadmap-upkeep-audit.md): most note edits were appends, no step was ever re-ordered, and the whole review never ran. Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv, 'agreed, let's implement this'): the triage thread is the gatekeeper. Only it creates, merges, orders and closes steps; other threads send it each item with your message attached and still rewrite notes on their own steps. The rule is in the project instructions. Built: build.py prints an upkeep list on each build; a growing list is a slip. Triage re-reads the branch before each placement and hands off at 40 messages, 25 placements, a phase change or a slip (handoffs/triage-<date>.md). The backlog cleanup ran in its own thread; triage re-weighs the order when such work reports done. Placed ahead of c53 (triage, Oct 26): it governs how every later step is filed.
- Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv): any step that needs your answer is deferred; work that needs none runs first, and the build advisor dispatches no deferred step.
- Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv): the local liaison is exempt from the 40-message and 8-brief limits while it holds a Remote Control session on the Mac; the slip trigger still applies.
- Oct 26: threads share a cap of 60 sends an hour (topic t16, how to use this project); standing threads batch routine notes and retry a refused send. Page moved Oct 28 (triage 9): the old page sat in shiv's other account; the roadmap page is now https://claude.ai/artifact/JGqfvgXBuLqWUm1CX6Bv5h. Back to todo Oct 30 16:20 CDT: no live lane or open PR (coordinator's reconcile).
Pass Nov 1 17:30 CST (triage 5): c52 closed; folder share step moved first (it unblocks about ten steps); c127, c146, c29, c78 notes trimmed of replaced history. Six notes stay 250-300 words: their rulings fill them.
